I suggested Ilse check with Tobias Rendle or Hollis Mbeki (Central) or June Osei-Lark (deal desk), and treat the date as hearsay until one of them confirms it.

My reply says "I've noted it as unverified," but I didn't actually record it anywhere. It's acknowledged only in that thread reply.
